description:
## Why

PKIX-9vnx.6 decomposition step 1. The Lint trait today has 5 required metadata accessors (id, citation, severity, scope, applies_to) but no OSCAL-Control-grade fields (title, description, RFC section, citation URL). This bead adds them as default methods so the existing 6 CABF lint impls keep compiling.

## What

Extend the `Lint` trait in `pkix-lint/src/lib.rs` with these default methods (Option (a) — discrete methods per PKIX-9vnx.6 notes):

- `fn title(&self) -> &str` — default: returns `self.id()`.
- `fn description(&self) -> Option<&str>` — default: `None`.
- `fn rfc_section_id(&self) -> Option<&str>` — default: `None`. Example value: `"rfc5280-4.2.1.9"` (OSCAL Control-id-shaped).
- `fn rfc_url(&self) -> Option<&str>` — default: `None`. Example: `"https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5280#section-4.2.1.9"`.

Override these in the 6 existing CABF lints (`cabf_tls_br.rs`) to declare the TLS BR section ID + URL where applicable. The CABF lints' citation strings like `"TLS BR §6.3.2 (SC-081)"` stay; the new methods are additive.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Lint trait has the 4 new default methods.
- [ ] Each method has rustdoc with OSCAL Control-field mapping.
- [ ] Existing 6 CABF lints override at least `rfc_section_id` and `rfc_url` (where a stable URL exists for the TLS BR section).
- [ ] Tests verify metadata returns for each existing lint.
- [ ] Full pkix-lint suite passes default + --features oscal + --all-features.
- [ ] Clippy clean.

## Out of scope

- OSCAL Catalog JSON serialization — that's .6.2.
- Round-trip via JSON Catalog — that's .6.3.
- Parameter mechanism — that's .6.4.
title: Lint trait OSCAL-Control metadata methods (foundational)
